title: Retry-After interoperability policy for Northstar staging
body: Wes Contract decides Retry-After interoperability for Northstar staging. For this rollout accept unsigned finite decimal seconds and a leading plus sign, including 0.5 and +3. Keep integer seconds and HTTP dates working. Reject negatives, exponents, NaN and infinity with InvalidHeader. Preserve retry_after_max clamping, backoff and retry safety. This is a proposal for the rollout and needs owner confirmation. Add narrow unit tests; no change to automatic retry methods.
author: Wes Contract
